title: Oxygen and carbon dioxide rules judged by partial pressure (GEN.1320, GEN.1321, GEN.1331)
status: Boss, 11:19 PM EST on 2026-11-06: the oxygen window stays at the limits as built, but oxygen is judged by partial pressure wherever it gates life or class (M, H, L, O, P, R, K, F and the life gates), and carbon dioxide by partial pressure on the oxygen-water classes. Shares stay for hydrogen, sulfur dioxide, methane, the reducing share, class G and class W's limits. This file lists every rule that was converted and every rule that deliberately stays a share, so a test (tests/test_partial_pressure_rules.py) fails when a share-based oxygen or carbon dioxide threshold turns up in a converted rule or in a place this list does not name.

pressure_quantities.o2_partial_pa: the oxygen's own partial pressure, Pa
pressure_quantities.co2_partial_pa: the carbon dioxide's own partial pressure, Pa

share_quantities.share_o2: the oxygen's partial pressure over the surface pressure
share_quantities.share_co2: the carbon dioxide's partial pressure over the surface pressure

kept_as_share.reason: class F is 'not carbon-dioxide-rich', the other side of class G's 20 percent line, and class G stays a share (Boss, 11:19 PM EST on 2026-11-06)
class G is a carbon dioxide air whatever the oxygen: a share of the molecules, the line Boss kept (registry AW5)

dense-CO2 life needs carbon dioxide to be the air's bulk (the solvent is the air), a medium rule and not a breathing one; its phase is read from the total pressure (open question in reports/gen1331-partial-pressure-sweep-2026-11-08.md)
the settling time of a reducing air asks whether there is practically no free oxygen next to a reducing share (chemistry of an outgassing air, the reducing share stays a share)
the same 20 percent of the air line as class G, which Boss kept as a share (11:19 PM EST on 2026-11-06)
